# Author recording handoff

reading-script.md is byte-identical to the original nineteen-paragraph manuscript. The named cut scripts contain exact excerpts in visual order. Record naturally; 24/45/60/120-second timings are placeholders to be revised to the recording. Supply an unprocessed mono WAV, preferably 48 kHz / 24 bit, and room tone.

The kit supplies a synthetic ambient bed, not location sound. No generated voice is used. Final mix, spoken Vietnamese subtitle timing and reviewed English translation await the author recording. The existing SRT/VTT describe on-screen text timing, not recorded dialogue.
